components.description: Asks for missing intent or states assumptions when an AI response would otherwise guess.

c.text: Three deals are at risk this quarter.
The agent answers but tags the assumption it made, inviting correction without blocking.
Clarification with quick-pick buttons, faster than free text when the choices are small.
